_: The apps installer/tjommie.nsi can build (spec section 4). appId, product and exe are Core's identity table (tjommie-rs/crates/desktop-host/src/identity.rs). guid is electron-builder's name-based UUID of the appId (namespace below); production's is the one R1 registers, recorded in r1-install-facts.json. root: programs = always %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\<folder>; temp = a folder two levels under %TEMP%, named for the product, given with /D= (R1's update test installs there). scripts/installer.test.ts proves each value, and that no two identities share a GUID, folder, product name, exe or AppUserModelID.
